# Calder Morton-Ferguson

> Mathematician and research scientist working on machine learning, with a background in geometric representation theory.

This is Calder Morton-Ferguson's personal research website. Researcher identity is also linked through ORCID, Google Scholar, GitHub, and LinkedIn on the homepage.

## Main pages
- [Biography and papers](https://caldermf.github.io/): Current research interests, academic background, and the full publication list.
- [Papers](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/): Papers grouped by original arXiv year; journal publication dates are listed separately.
- [Research software and notes](https://caldermf.github.io/projects/): Projects, interactive demonstrations, talks, and notes.
- [Teaching](https://caldermf.github.io/teaching/): Mathematics teaching experience.
- [CV](https://caldermf.github.io/cv/): Academic CV; also available as a [PDF](https://caldermf.github.io/assets/pdf/cv.pdf).

## Structured and plain-text research data
- [Researcher profile](https://caldermf.github.io/profile.json): Schema.org Person data with verified profile links.
- [Publication data](https://caldermf.github.io/publications.json): Titles, authors, original arXiv dates, abstracts, journal details, and source links.
- [Publications in Markdown](https://caldermf.github.io/publications.md): Readable paper summaries and abstracts.
- [BibTeX bibliography](https://caldermf.github.io/publications.bib): Bibliographic records retaining journal publication years.

## Papers
- [ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/reapo/): Nghi Dao, Calder Morton-Ferguson, Noah Golowich, Adam Block.
- [A bar operation on the double affine Hecke algebra](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/baroperation/): Dougal Davis, Ivan Losev, Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Markov chains on Weyl groups from the geometry of the flag variety](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/markovchains/): Persi Diaconis, Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Weight modules and gluing of sheaves on the flag variety](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/weightmodules/): Pablo Boixeda Alvarez, Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Modular reduction of complex representations of finite reductive groups](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/modular/): Roman Bezrukavnikov, Michael Finkelberg, David Kazhdan, Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Perverse sheaves and t-structures on the thin and thick affine flag varieties](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/thinthick/): Roman Bezrukavnikov, Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Polishchuk’s conjecture and Kazhdan-Laumon representations](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/cmfrationality/): Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Symplectic Fourier–Deligne Transforms on G/U and the Algebra of Braids and Ties](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/cmfsymplectic/): Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Kazhdan-Laumon category O, Braverman-Kazhdan Schwartz space, and the semi-infinite flag variety](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/cmfcato/): Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Heaps, crystals, and preprojective algebra modules](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/dekm/): Anne Dranowski, Balázs Elek, Joel Kamnitzer, Calder Morton-Ferguson.
- [Appendix to "The Mirković-Vilonen basis and Duistermaat-Heckman measures"](https://caldermf.github.io/publications/appendix/): Anne Dranowski, Joel Kamnitzer, Calder Morton-Ferguson.
